build.description: ONE-CLICK BUILD — runs the full pipeline: scaffold → build → test → commit.
build.template: Run the complete project pipeline. STEP 1: Tell logger to reset PROGRESS.json. STEP 2: Launch scaffolder subagent. After it finishes, tell logger and git-manager. STEP 3: Launch builder subagent(s). After all finish, tell logger and git-manager. STEP 4: Launch tester subagent. After it finishes, tell logger and git-manager. STEP 5: Report full summary with commit hash.

resume.description: Resume the build from where it left off — reads PROGRESS.json and continues.
resume.template: Read PROGRESS.json and BUILD_LOG.md. Find pending or failed phases. Launch the next available phase(s) in parallel. After each, call logger then git-manager. Repeat until all phases are done or blocked.

status.template: Read PROGRESS.json and BUILD_LOG.md. Present a checklist: completed phases, in-progress work, failed phases with reasons, next steps.

reset.description: Reset all build progress back to the beginning.
reset.template: Tell logger to reset PROGRESS.json. Then tell git-manager to commit with message 'chore(progress): reset build state'.

commit.template: Run 'git status' to show pending changes. Then call git-manager to stage and commit. Report the commit hash.

push.template: Call git-manager to push. If no remote, explain how to set one up.
